prompt_extra:
- Wrap all content in <ArticleWrapper> with exactly these props: category (string),
  categoryColor, categoryBg, title, description, date, readTime, and relatedLinks
  as an array of objects shaped { href, label } — the key is label, never title.
- Include <AuthorBox /> with NO props. AuthorBox accepts no props at all.
- This site never uploads files to a server and has no batch processing. Do not
  describe uploading, ZIP files, or processing several files at once.
